items.title: Derive the DONE-required phase deadline from sequential command budgets
items.context: Replace the unrelated 240-second DONE-required phase default with sum(effective ordered command timeouts) plus bounded grace in one shared timeout-budget core. Coordinate the default CLI absolute max for done_required_validate and done_prepare so it cannot be shorter than the legal derived inner work; an explicit LATTICE_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS remains authoritative. Preserve global/per-phase overrides, per-command attribution, cleanup, human/JSON budget source, and a non-repeating timeout hint.
items.userSees: done_prepare prints “DONE-required validation budget: <N>ms (derived)” and either completes the legal suite or names the bounded timeout and a changed next action.

items.title: Reuse structurally fresh DONE-required evidence during done_prepare
items.context: Before spawning done_required_validate, consume canonical freshness/admissibility checks plus metadata-only HEAD lineage. Add reuseFreshDoneRequired (default true) as an independent switch; false forces execution when validate=true. validate:false always records skipped_explicitly and neither reuses, executes, nor manufactures evidence. Human/JSON expose disposition executed|reused|skipped_explicitly, result pass|failed|timed_out|blocked|not_run, refusalReasons, and timeoutLayer.
items.userSees: done_prepare prints “DONE-required validation: reused” or “DONE-required validation: executed”, and JSON reports the same disposition plus refusal reasons.

items.title: Keep long active DONE-required commands alive without weakening timeout safety
items.context: Bridge direct done_required_validate progress/heartbeat through ctx.log so active silent commands survive the CLI idle watchdog. Preserve command timeoutMs, derived outer deadline, coordinated absolute max, JSON stdout isolation, process-tree cleanup, validation-lock cleanup, and explicit LATTICE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS/LATTICE_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS overrides.
items.userSees: direct done_required_validate prints periodic “validate heartbeat” progress and ends with PASS or one attributed bounded failure while --json remains a single parseable result.
